caption: The drawing depicts a young child with short light brown hair, wearing a checked brown and tan suit consisting of a matching jacket and knee-length pants. The jacket features a large collar, decorative buttons, and wide lapels, along with a large brown bow at the neck over a white shirt with a ruffled collar visible underneath. The pants have buttons at the cuffs and reach just below the knees. The child is also wearing beige or light brown socks folded over just below the knees and brown button-up boots. The background is plain and light-colored, featuring no additional objects or elements, and the signature "Eugene Croe" is visible at the bottom right corner.
title: Doll: "Donald"
